cell_type: UDP-glucose pyrophosphorylase (UGP), the enzyme responsible for the synthesis of the sugar nucleotide UDP-glucose, is localized in the cytosol and glycosomes of the bloodstream and procyclic trypanosomes
sample_source: The procyclic form of T. brucei EATRO1125.T7T (TetR-HYG T7RNAPOL-NEO, where TetR stands for tetracycline resistance, HYG is hygromycin, POL is polymerase, and NEO is neomycin) was cultured at 27°C in SDM79 medium
cell_line: Incidentally, a comparative proteomic analysis of the previously obtained PEPCK null (\u0394pepck) mutant and the parental cell line, carried out in order to control the PEPCK gene deletion, showed a strong reduction (19.7-fold) of UGP peptide counts in the enriched glycosomal fractions of the mutant (see the PXD020190 data set in the PRIDE partner repository).
